title: VTC Roles — Define — payload
description: Create a custom administrative role at a VTC, or replace an existing custom role. Built-in roles are not definable. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

name.description: Name of the custom role. MUST NOT be a built-in role name.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the role.

ceiling.description: The role's capability ceiling, stated in full (it replaces any previous ceiling wholesale). Every capability MUST be in the VTC's registry, MUST NOT be one the registry classes as additive, and MUST be held — at a qualifier at least as wide — by the administrators whose authority defines the role. An empty array defines a role that admits no capability.

approveScope.description: The role's approve ceiling, stated in full. Every capability MUST be in the registry and within what the defining administrators may themselves approve. An empty array defines a role that approves nothing.

replaces.description: `true` to replace an existing custom role of this name; `false` or absent to create one. A create against an existing name is refused with `exists`, and a replace against a missing one with `notFound`, so neither intent can be mistaken for the other.

reason.description: Optional human-readable rationale, recorded with the change and shown to approvers.

Response.title: VTC Roles — Define — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/roles/define/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/roles/define/0.1#response.

role.description: The role record the VTC now holds, with `builtIn: false` and its provenance.
